args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 February.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", which is the old name.
- Because "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), the old and new names make searches return the wrong account.
- Pellow Home Living is the Mid-Atlantic home goods account; Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account.

The saved report label needs updating to the full name, Pellow Home Living.

Sofia Marchetti
